Car B, last class's fast car, is 15 m behind the AV in the left lane, at 15 m/s (chosen). The AV drives at 10 m/s; the parked car is 58 m ahead. Prediction puts car B straight on at 15 m/s: a constant velocity, the simplest prediction model. Move the time.

time from nowtry it
The issueLast class's planner checked paths, which have no time. It could not tell whether the AV would reach the left lane before car B or after it, so the behavior layer closed the lane. Fix: the local planner checks each candidate itself: where the AV will be at each moment, against where prediction puts car B at that same moment.
